title: Refund per Standing Day: Closing and Funding Prepaid Interest Disputes
content:
**Clause.** In a Closing and Funding prepaid interest dispute decision, the per diem the note supports is the loan file's loan amount times the rate the closing's lock holds, taken as a percent, divided by the per diem day-count basis, rounded half up to the cent. The loan amount is read from the borrower's Mortgage Loan File and the rate from the borrower's Rate Lock Commitment.

The refund per standing day is set as follows: where the disbursement date falls after the last day of the disputed charge and the ledger carries no charge for the month in which the loan funded (no prepaid interest charge whose period starts on the disbursement date), it is the disputed charge's whole daily amount, since none of those days was owed or set off; where that does not hold and the disputed charge used a daily amount above the per diem the note supports, it is the charge's daily amount less that per diem; otherwise it is zero.

| Disbursement after the charge's last day, with no funding-month charge? | Charge's daily amount vs. per diem the note supports | Refund per standing day |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | any | the charge's whole daily amount |
| No | above | the charge's daily amount less that per diem |
| No | at or below | zero |

## Cases (hypothetical; per diem the note supports 71.23)

| Situation | Charge's daily amount | Refund per standing day |
|---|---|---|
| disbursed after the charge; no funding-month charge on the ledger | 74.10 | 74.10 |
| disbursed after the charge; a funding-month charge stands | 74.10 | 2.87 |
| disbursed within the charge | 74.10 | 2.87 |
| disbursed within the charge | 69.86 | 0.00 |
